strings: !This program cannot be run in DOS mode.
Do you wish to play another game of Nim? Enter 'y' to continue.
Welcome to the game of Nim!
This game contains several piles of sticks, each containing a various number of them.
You and your opponent, the computer AI, will each take turns removing a specified number of sticks
from a chosen pile until no piles contain any sticks.
The player to remove the last sticks from the last pile loses.
How many piles do you wish to have?
Congratulations, player, you have won the game of Nim!
Sorry, the computer has beaten you. Better luck next time!
Please enter the pile you wish to remove sticks from.
You may only select a pile that still has sticks in it!
Please enter how many sticks you wish to remove from pile {0}.
Do you wish to play first?
Enter 'y' to play first, otherwise you will go second.
You, the user, will go first.
Please enter how many sticks you wish there to be in pile {0}.
The minimum value must be less than the maximum value!
You may only enter whole numbers.
You may only enter numbers between {0} and {1}.
No COM ports found. Please attach a COM-port device.
The system is now in checkout mode. To exist checkout mode, press OK.
Count must be positive and less than {0}
Demonstrates communications between two COM ports
